_comment: This file holds what JJ Flexible says and shows, for the logging area. Logging and cluster. EDITING: change the text on the right of the colon; never change the key on the left, and never change anything inside curly braces such as {radio} - those are filled in at run time with the actual radio name, frequency and so on. A key whose text is missing is spoken as the key itself, so if you hear something like connect.radio_found read out literally, that key needs text. YOUR OWN COPY: put a file of this same name in the lexicon folder beside your settings and it layers on top of this one, key by key - you only need the keys you want to change, and everything else keeps working. If your file has a typo in it, it is ignored and this one is used, so a mistake can never stop the program. LADDERS: a key may hold three tiers instead of one string - critical, terse and chatty - which is how one message gets shorter as you turn verbosity down. This partition is empty; the extraction tracks fill it. See docs/planning/active/string-store-contract.md.
logging.problem.announcement: {what}. Press Control J then Control R for details.
logging.problems.lead_truncated: Newest first. The oldest entries have been dropped from this list to keep it manageable, but the diagnostic log still has them.
logging.problems.lead: Newest first. Each line gives the time, what failed, and what it means.
logging.problems.no_log: No diagnostic log is running, so this list is all there is about these problems. You can turn a log on in Settings, Diagnostics, and it will record what happens from then on.
logging.problems.log_running: The diagnostic log recorded far more about each of these than this list shows. It stays on this computer. Nothing is sent anywhere.
logging.problems.open_failed: The problems list could not be opened.
logging.problems.save_failed: The diagnostic log could not be copied. It is still in the settings folder.
logging.problems.copy_failed: The problems could not be copied to the clipboard.
